about: A free tool companies use to keep track of their IT equipment and software licenses.

prs.title: Warranty end dates stay in the right month
prs.broken: A one month warranty bought on August 31 ended on October 1, because the date spilled past the shorter month. Expiry alerts used the same sum.
prs.changed: Warranty dates and the alert window now stop on the last day of the month, so that purchase ends on September 30.
prs.matters: Staff see the true warranty end date and get alerts on time.
